result.instructions: Tools for Fillout, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Fillout data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run fillout_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fillout_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fillout_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. fillout_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fillout_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List every form in the Fillout account — each form's name and formId. Start here to find the formId the other tools need. Fillout: GET /forms.

tools.name: fillout_get_form
tools.title: Get form questions and metadata
tools.description: Fetch one form's metadata: every question (id, name, type), calculations, URL parameters, scheduling and payment fields, and quiz settings. Use the question ids to read answers or to create submissions. Fillout: GET /forms/{formId}.

formId.description: The form's public id (the formId from fillout_list_forms, also the id in the form's share URL).

tools.name: fillout_list_submissions
tools.title: List submissions
tools.description: List one page of a form's submissions (answers to every question, calculations, URL parameters, scheduling, payments, quiz score, login email), filtered by date range, status or free-text search. Offset pagination: the response carries totalResponses and pageCount. Fillout: GET /forms/{formId}/submissions.

formId.description: The form's public id (the formId from fillout_list_forms, also the id in the form's share URL).

afterDate.description: Only submissions submitted after this ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

beforeDate.description: Only submissions submitted before this ISO 8601 date-time.

sort.description: Sort by submission time: 'asc' (default) or 'desc' for newest first.

includeEditLink.description: Include an editLink for each submission.

tools.name: fillout_get_submission
tools.title: Get one submission
tools.description: Fetch a single submission by id, with every answer. Fillout: GET /forms/{formId}/submissions/{submissionId}.

formId.description: The form's public id (the formId from fillout_list_forms, also the id in the form's share URL).

includeEditLink.description: Include an editLink for the submission.

tools.name: fillout_count_submissions
tools.title: Count submissions
tools.description: Count a form's submissions matching the same filters as fillout_list_submissions (date range, status, search) without pulling the answers — e.g. 'how many responses this week?' or 'how many partial submissions?'. Reads totalResponses from GET /forms/{formId}/submissions with limit=1.

formId.description: The form's public id (the formId from fillout_list_forms, also the id in the form's share URL).

afterDate.description: Only submissions submitted after this ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

beforeDate.description: Only submissions submitted before this ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: fillout_export_submissions
tools.title: Export submissions
tools.description: Fetch many submissions in one call by walking the offset pagination (150 per page, paced under Fillout's 5 requests/second limit), up to max_submissions. Same filters as fillout_list_submissions. Use this for analysis across a whole response set; the result says whether it was truncated. Fillout: GET /forms/{formId}/submissions (repeated).

formId.description: The form's public id (the formId from fillout_list_forms, also the id in the form's share URL).

afterDate.description: Only submissions submitted after this ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

beforeDate.description: Only submissions submitted before this ISO 8601 date-time.

max_submissions.description: Stop after this many submissions (default 500, max 3000).

tools.name: fillout_create_submissions
tools.title: Create submissions
tools.description: Create up to 10 new submissions on a form, as if respondents had filled it in — e.g. to import responses collected elsewhere. Each submission needs its question answers (question ids from fillout_get_form); URL parameters, scheduling, payments, login email and timestamps are optional. Creates real records that trigger the form's integrations. Fillout: POST /forms/{formId}/submissions.

formId.description: The form's public id (the formId from fillout_list_forms, also the id in the form's share URL).

value.description: The answer, shaped for the question type (string, number, array of choices, object...).

submissionTime.description: When it was submitted, ISO 8601 (default now).

lastUpdatedAt.description: When it was last updated, ISO 8601.

payments.description: Payment answers (records only; no money moves).

value.description: A record of an existing Stripe payment — this does NOT charge anyone.

tools.name: fillout_create_webhook
tools.title: Create a submission webhook
tools.description: Subscribe a URL to a form's new submissions: Fillout will POST each submission (same shape as a fillout_list_submissions entry) to it. Returns the webhook id — keep it, it is the only handle for removing the webhook later. Fillout: POST /webhook/create.

formId.description: The form's public id (the formId from fillout_list_forms, also the id in the form's share URL).

url.description: The HTTPS endpoint that should receive submissions.

tools.name: fillout_remove_webhook
tools.title: Remove a submission webhook
tools.description: Stop a webhook from receiving submissions. Recoverable: create it again with fillout_create_webhook (it gets a new id). Fillout: POST /webhook/delete.

webhookId.description: The webhook id returned by fillout_create_webhook.
